format.patterns: Regular expression sources, all matched ignoring case. A message is retryable when it matches a retryable pattern and no nonRetryable one; it is a context overflow when it matches an overflow pattern and no nonOverflow one.
format.cases: For each error message, isRetryableAssistantError and isContextOverflow of an assistant message that failed with it. The provider is not Cerebras, whose bodyless 400 and 413 upstream also reads as overflow.
